gameBlurb: Breach casts the player control of a spacecraft under siege by an unknown mechanical enemy force. Trapped inside the Main Control Room, the player decides to distribute resources and act through a surveillance system, watching four key rooms via camera feeds and deciding where to route limited Power to activate pre-placed turrets and traps. Losing sight of a room isn't just inconvenient, it results with dealing with enemies firsthand. If defenses in a room collapse, enemies stop being a distant threat and start breaching into the Control Room itself, closing the distance between watching the fight and being in it.
